name: Scan IP Address
description: Submit an IP address to PolySwarm's engine marketplace for a fresh multi-engine verdict, via the URL scanning endpoint since PolySwarm has no separate IP endpoint. Spends a scan and creates account activity; reuses an existing result unless force_rescan is set.

ip.description: The IP address to scan. Submitted to PolySwarm's engine marketplace as a URL artifact, which spends a scan unless a matching result already exists. Private, loopback, link-local and other internal addresses are refused rather than submitted.

scan_config.description: How long PolySwarm waits for engines to answer before returning a verdict: 'default' is fastest; 'more-time' and 'most-time' wait longer so more engines can finish, at the cost of a slower playbook run.

detect_threshold.description: How many malicious engine detections activate the detected branch. Default of 1 flags on any single detection.

force_rescan.description: Skip the check for an existing result and submit a new scan. This spends a scan even when PolySwarm already has a result for this IP address, so leave it off unless you need a fresh verdict.

max_wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for the engines to finish a new scan, in seconds, from 30 to 600. A larger value is rejected with a validation error. Only applies when a new scan is submitted. If the engines have not finished by then the action stops with an error and the scan keeps running at PolySwarm, so look the result up again later.

sha256.description: SHA256 hash of the scan artifact

permalink.description: Link to the PolySwarm scan result

polyscore.description: PolySwarm threat score (0.0 - 1.0). The score is built around file artifacts. For a URL, a domain or an address, branch on the detection counts rather than on this score. Null when PolySwarm returned no score.

malicious_count.description: Number of engines that flagged the IP as malicious

benign_count.description: Number of engines that flagged the IP as benign

total_count.description: Total number of engines that responded

cached.description: Whether the result came from an existing scan instead of a new submission

engine_name.description: Name of the engine that returned this verdict

author_name.description: Name of the party that authored the engine

verdict.description: What the engine answered: true for malicious, false for benign, null when the engine abstained, which counts as neither

outputs.not detected: PolySwarm has scanned this artifact and no engine detected it
